verse: So it is as the Holy Spirit says: Today listen to what he says. Do not be stubborn as in the past when you turned against God. There you tested God in the desert. For 40 years in the desert your ancestors saw the things I did. But they tested me and my patience. I was angry with them. I said, They are not loyal to me. They have not understood my ways. So I was angry and made a promise. They will never enter my land of rest. So brothers, be careful that none of you has an evil, unbelieving heart. This will stop you from following the living God.
